caseName: Brown ex rel. Situated v. Livingston
caseNameFull: Bobby R. BROWN, Individually and on Behalf of All Others Similarly Situated, applicant v. Brad LIVINGSTON, Executive Director, Texas Department of Criminal Justice.

opinions.text: Application to vacate stay entered by the United States of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit on May 20, 2014, presented to Justice SCALIA and by him referred to the Court denied.
